children.name: text
children: Any term importing the singular includes the plural and vice versa and any reference to person includes individuals, partnerships, corporate bodies and any entity having legal capacity.

children.name: text
children: References to Statutory Requirements include those Statutory Requirements as from time to time amended, re-enacted or consolidated and any orders, regulations, rules and the like issued under or in connection with the same.

children.name: text
children: References to party or parties means the Contractor and/or the Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: This Subcontract shall not be construed or interpreted against or to the disadvantage of the Contractor on the grounds that this Subcontract represents the Contractor's standard terms and conditions of business and/or that this Subcontract and/or any particular term or condition hereof may have originated from the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Where under this Subcontract an act is required to be done within a specified period of days after or from a specified date, the period shall begin immediately after that date. Where the period  would  include  Christmas  Day,  Good  Friday  or  a  day  which  under  the  Banking  and Financial Dealings Act 1971 is a bank holiday that day shall be excluded.

children.name: text
children: Any words following the terms "including", "include", "in particular" or any similar expression shall  be  construed  as  illustrative  and  shall  not  limit  the  sense  of  the  words,  description, definition, phrase or terms preceding those terms.

children.name: text
children: No  failure  or  delay  by  the  Contractor  to  exercise  any  right  or  remedy  provided  under  this Subcontract or in law (including the exercise of any condition precedent) ("remedy") or the single or partial exercise of that remedy constitutes a waiver of that remedy or precludes or restricts further exercise of that remedy.

children.name: text
children: {b:Applicable Conditions}

children.name: text
children: This Subcontract constitutes the entire agreement between the parties relating to the subject matter of  this Subcontract and supersedes and extinguishes any prior drafts, agreements, undertakings,  representations, warranties and arrangements of any  nature  whatsoever, whether or not in writing, between  the parties in relation to the subject matter of this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: Further, this Subcontract is subject to these conditions to the exclusion of any terms and conditions  stipulated or referred to by the Subcontractor in its  quotation, any of its correspondence or its subsequent acknowledgement of the Subcontract Order. The carrying out of the Subcontract Works or any part of them by the Subcontractor is deemed to be acceptance of these conditions and no conduct on the part of the Contractor (including any instruction to start work whether on or off Site) shall constitute an acceptance of any terms and conditions put forward by the Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: The parties acknowledge and agree that they have not entered into this Subcontract in reliance on any statement or representation of any person (whether a party to this Subcontract or not) other than as expressly incorporated in this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: The Contract Documents forming this Subcontract are to be taken as mutually explanatory of one another. If there is any conflict, ambiguity or discrepancy, the priority of the Contract Documents shall be in accordance with the following sequence:

children.name: text
children: Appendix 13 Pre-Let Meeting Minutes;

children.name: text
children: Appendix 6 QLL Terms and Conditions;

children.name: text
children: Subcontract Order;

children.name: text
children: {mark:[XXXX];} and

children.name: text
children: all other Contract Documents.

children.name: text
children: If the Subcontractor finds an ambiguity or discrepancy  in the Contract Documents, it shall promptly give notice to the Contractor describing the same.

children.name: text
children: After receiving such notice, or if the Contractor itself finds an ambiguity or discrepancy in the Contract Documents, the Contractor shall issue the necessary clarification or instruction to the Subcontractor which the Subcontractor shall comply with without any entitlement to adjustment of the Price or the Period for Completion.

children.name: text
children: No amendment to this Subcontract is valid and binding unless authorised in writing by the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: This Subcontract is governed by and is to be construed in accordance with English law.

children.name: text
children: The parties irrevocably agree that the courts of England and Wales shall have exclusive jurisdiction to settle any dispute which may arise out of or in connection with this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: {b:Main Contract & Third Party Agreements}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor acknowledges, warrants and undertakes that it is, and shall be deemed to be, fully aware of the terms of the Main Contract and any Third Party Agreement whether or not actually inspected. The Contractor shall, if so requested by the Subcontractor, provide the Subcontractor with copies of the Main Contract and any Third Party Agreement (with financial details and commercially sensitive details redacted).

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall carry out and complete the Subcontract Works in such manner and at such times so that no act, omission or default of the Subcontractor in relation thereto shall cause or contribute to any breach by the Contractor of any of its obligations under the Main Contract or any Third Party Agreement.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall facilitate the Contractor's compliance with any and all procedures laid down in the Main Contract and any Third Party Agreement for the approval of changes in design, specification or materials and/or the testing, commissioning and/or inspection of the works or any part or parts of the works comprising the Subcontract Works for which the Subcontractor is responsible under this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: To the extent that the Contractor accepts responsibility for the contents of the Employer's Requirements  under  the  Main Contract,  the  Subcontractor  shall  have  the  same  degree  of responsibility under this Subcontract to the extent that the Employer's Requirements relate to the part or parts of the Subcontract Works that the Subcontractor is designing.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor has checked the Employer's Requirements and:

children.name: text
children: is satisfied that the Employer's Requirements are feasible, practical and sufficient to enable the  Subcontractor to carry out its obligations for the design and/or construction of the Subcontract Works to the extent set out therein and the Subcontractor has agreed to accept responsibility for such feasibility, practicality and sufficiency insofar as they relate to the Subcontractor's responsibility for the design and/or construction of the Subcontract Works; and

children.name: text
children: confirms that there is no mistake, inaccuracy,  inconsistency, discrepancy or divergence in or between this Subcontract and the Employer's Requirements; and

children.name: text
children: confirms that the Subcontract Works shall meet the Employer's Requirements and that the Subcontractor has taken full account of the Employer's Requirements.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall indemnify and keep the Contractor indemnified against all claims arising under the Main Contract, the Employer's Requirements, or any Third Party Agreement as a result of the Subcontractor's acts and/or omissions, breaches and/or defaults which cause the Contractor or the Employer to suffer or be in breach of the Main Contract, the Employer's Requirements, or any Third Party Agreement or to incur any liability as a result of a breach of this Clause 3.

children.name: text
children: {b:Subcontractor's Obligations}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall carry out and complete the Subcontract Works:

children.name: text
children: in a proper and workmanlike manner and in compliance with this Subcontract;

children.name: text
children: regularly and diligently and in accordance with the Programme and the progress of the Project;

children.name: text
children: to the standard to be expected of a professional and competent contractor of the Subcontractor's specialist discipline who is experienced in working on projects of a similar, size, scope, nature, complexity and value to the Subcontract Works;

children.name: text
children: in accordance with the instructions issued from time to time by the Contractor and all other reasonable requirements of the Contractor;

children.name: text
children: in accordance with the Statutory Requirements and the requirements of any local authority or statutory undertaker;

children.name: text
children: in compliance with the Construction (Design and Management) Regulations 2015 ("{b:CDM}") and the Construction Phase Plan (pursuant to CDM Regulation 12); and

children.name: text
children: in compliance with the Contractor's health and safety policy, and all applicable health and safety legislation, including but not limited to the Health and Safety at Work Act 1974 and any requirements of the Health and Safety Executive.

children.name: text
children: Unless otherwise stated in the Minutes, the Subcontractor shall be responsible at its own cost for  all permissions, consents, approvals, notices,  and  applications necessary for the Subcontract Works. For the avoidance of doubt, the Subcontractor shall have no responsibility for procuring any required planning permissions, listed building consents or building control approvals.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall ensure that its employees, agents and all other persons employed or engaged on or in connection with the Subcontract Works are registered cardholders under the Construction  Skills Certification Scheme (CSCS) or qualified under an equivalent recognised qualification scheme.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor must comply with any request made by the Contractor to remove any person employed or engaged by the Subcontractor on the Project without liability or cost to the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor is to provide on Site during working hours a competent person authorised to receive instructions on behalf of the Subcontractor and to ensure the proper administration, co-ordination and supervision of the Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: {b:Materials and Goods}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor warrants and undertakes to the Contractor that it has not specified and will not use and (as appropriate) it has not and will not authorise or approve the specification or use by others within the Subcontract Works of materials or goods which are:

children.name: text
children: generally known at the time of use to be deleterious to health and safety or to the durability  of  buildings  and/or  other  structures  and/or  finishes  and/or  plant  and machinery in the particular circumstances in which they are used;

children.name: text
children: not in conformity with good building practice, relevant British standards or codes of practice;

children.name: text
children: not  new  (except  where  expressly  permitted  under  this  Subcontract)  and  of satisfactory quality;

children.name: text
children: in contravention of the recommendations of the publications "Good Practice in the Selection of Construction  Materials" (2011, published  by  the  British Council for Offices) or the Building Research  Establishment Digest current at the date of specification.

children.name: text
children: Should the Subcontractor become aware that any materials or goods have been used in the Project in breach of this Clause 5, it shall inform the Contractor immediately in writing.

children.name: text
children: The  Subcontractor  shall  use  the  standard  of  skill,  care  and  diligence  referred  to  in  Clause 4.1.3  to  keep  the  Contractor  advised  of  any  research  or  other  information  of  which  the Subcontractor  is  or  ought  reasonably  to  be  aware  and  which  ought  properly  to  cause  the Contractor to give consideration to the safety of the design or manner of construction of the Project or of any materials incorporated therein.

children.name: text
children: {b:Design}

children.name: text
children: To  the  extent  the  Subcontractor  is  responsible  for  the  design  of  all  or  any  part  of  the Subcontract   Works,   the   Subcontractor   shall   provide   copies   of   all   drawings,   details, specifications and other documents for comment by the Contractor within the timescale stated in  the  Minutes  or,  where  no  timescale  is  stated,  in  sufficient  time  to  avoid  delay  to  the Subcontract Works and the Project.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor at its own cost shall take into account any comments of the Contractor and incorporate them into the drawings, specifications, or other documents and re-submit them to the Contractor within a reasonable time period.

children.name: text
children: The  Subcontractor  shall  not  vary  the  design  of  the  Subcontract  Works  without  prior  written instruction from the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The  Subcontractor  warrants  to  the  Contractor  that  in  respect  of  any  design  for  which  it  is responsible, it has and will continue to exercise the same level of skill, care and diligence as the Contractor is required to exercise in respect of design under the Main Contract.

children.name: text
children: {b:Effect of Approvals}

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding  any  other  provision  of  this  Subcontract  no  direction,  admission,  approach, consent,  approval,  confirmation,  comment,  sanction,  acknowledgement  or  advice  made  or given  by  or  on  behalf  of  the  Contractor  shall  in  any  way  relieve  the  Subcontractor  from  its liabilities  or  obligations  under  this  Subcontract,  nor  shall  such  liabilities  or  obligations  be restricted or qualified in any way.

children.name: text
children: {b:Copyright}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor grants to the Contractor an irrevocable, royalty free, non-exclusive licence to copy and use the Documents and to reproduce the designs and the content of them for any purpose relating to the Project, including the construction, completion, maintenance, letting, sale, promotion, advertisement, reinstatement, refurbishment and repair of the Subcontract Works and the Project. The Subcontractor shall supply the Contractor (without charge) with a copy  of  the  Documents  immediately  on  the  Contractor's request (whether before or after termination of the Subcontract or the Subcontractor's employment under the Subcontract (including termination for breach by the Contractor)).

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall be liable for and shall indemnify the Contractor against any and all expenses, liabilities, losses, claims or proceedings the Contractor may incur in the event:

children.name: text
children: that the rights granted by the Subcontractor pursuant to this Clause 8 are found to be invalid, ineffective or impaired in any way; and/or

children.name: text
children: of any claim by any third party (whether upheld or not) that the exercise of the rights granted by the Subcontractor pursuant to this Clause 8 infringe the rights of such third party.

children.name: text
children: {b:Variations}

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may at any time issue written instructions to the Subcontractor in relation to the Subcontract Works including instructions requiring a variation to the Subcontract Works.  A variation includes any addition, alteration to and/or omission from the Subcontract Works.  The Contractor shall be entitled to omit any part of the Subcontract Works and may perform that work  either  by  itself  or  by  engaging  others.    The  Subcontractor  shall  have  no  claim  or entitlement to be paid the relevant portion of the Price for the omitted works, or any indirect or consequential loss including but not limited to loss of profit, loss of contract, or any other loss arising from that omission.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall forthwith comply with all instructions issued under Clause 9.1. If within 5  days  after  receipt  of  a  written  notice  from  the  Contractor  requiring  compliance  with  an instruction, the Subcontractor does not comply, then the Contractor may give effect to that instruction  itself  or  engage  others  to  do  so  and  the  Subcontractor  shall  be  liable  for  all additional costs incurred by the Contractor as a result, which the Contractor may set-off against the Price.

children.name: text
children: The fixed sum to be paid in respect of any variation is, where possible, to be agreed between the Contractor and the Subcontractor before the variation is carried out.

children.name: text
children: If the amount is not agreed it shall be valued by the Contractor in accordance with the rates and prices upon which the Price has been calculated or where, in the opinion of the Contractor such rates and prices cannot reasonably be used, at fair rates and values. The Contractor will notify the Subcontractor of the rates and values that it will use (which notification maybe by way of the valuation) and if the Subcontractor does not object in writing to those rates and values within 7 days of receipt of the notification the Subcontractor shall be deemed to have agreed those rates and values.

children.name: text
children: Not less than monthly during the carrying out of the Subcontract Works the Subcontractor shall submit to the Contractor, in such form and containing such detail and supporting information as the Contractor may require, details of the Subcontractor's forecasted final account which shall take account of all instructed and anticipated variations.

children.name: text
children: In  addition  to  providing  the  information  required  under  Clause  9.5,  if  the  Subcontractor considers  itself  entitled  to  an  adjustment  of  the  Price  under  this  Subcontract  it  shall,  as  a condition  precedent  to  consideration  by  the  Contractor,  give  notice  to  the  Contractor describing the event or circumstance giving rise to the claim, which notice must be given as soon as practicable and not later than 7 days after the Subcontractor became aware, or should have become aware, of the event or circumstance. If the Subcontractor does not give notice of  a  claim  within  such  period  of  7  days,  the  Subcontractor  shall  not  be  entitled  to  any adjustment of the Price and the Contractor shall be discharged from all liability in connection with the claim.  The provision of the details under Clause 9.5 does not constitute valid notice under this Clause 9.6.

children.name: text
children: {b:Subcontract attendances/facilities}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor is to supply all labour, materials, tools and plant necessary for carrying out the Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: Unless expressly stated otherwise in this Subcontract:

children.name: text
children: the Subcontractor shall at its own cost make all provision for transporting, loading, sorting,  storing,  protecting  and  insuring  its  materials,  plant  and  tools, and  the Contractor shall not be liable for any loss or damage to the same howsoever arising;

children.name: text
children: the  Subcontractor  at  its  own  cost  shall  provide  and  supply  all  necessary  lighting, power, water and security for the purposes of the Subcontract Works;

children.name: text
children: the Contractor will provide the facilities set out in the Attendance Schedule to the Subcontractor free of charge.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall keep the Site clean and tidy at all times and, at its own cost, remove its own spoil, waste and rubbish from Site.

children.name: text
children: {b:Commencement and Completion of the Subcontract Works}

children.name: text
children: Following receipt of a written notice to proceed from the Contractor, the Subcontractor shall commence the Subcontract Works on Site within the period stated in the Subcontract Order.

children.name: text
children: The  Subcontractor shall  achieve  practical  completion  of  the  Subcontract  Works  within  the Period for Completion, and shall use its best endeavours to prevent or mitigate any delay.

children.name: text
children: If  the  Subcontract  Works  are  delayed  or  are  likely  to  be  delayed,  the  Subcontractor  shall forthwith notify the Contractor in writing identifying the cause, with an estimate of the impact on the Period for Completion {b:("Delay Notice")}.

children.name: text
children: The Delay Notice must be issued not later than 7 days after the Subcontractor became aware, or  should  have  become  aware,  of  the  delay  or  likely  delay.  The  Contractor  shall  have  no obligation to consider any  Delay Notice issued after  this period, and the Subcontractor shall not be entitled to any extension of time under this Clause 11 in respect of that delay or likely delay.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor  may also identify in the Delay Notice any of the following events if in its reasonable opinion any are a relevant cause of the delay:

children.name: text
children: an instruction for a variation to the Subcontract Works under Clause 9.1;

children.name: text
children: failure by the Contractor to allow access to the Site when required during the Period for Completion;

children.name: text
children: any impediment, prevention or default, whether by act or omission by the Contractor or  those  engaged  on  the  Project  by  the  Contractor  or  any  party  for  whom  the Contractor is responsible;

children.name: text
children: the Subcontractor's proper exercise of its right to suspend all or any of its obligations under the Subcontract, then subject to Clauses 11.3 - 11.4, if the Contractor agrees that such event has caused the delay, and provided always that the Subcontractor shall not become entitled to any extension of time on account of any circumstance arising  by  reason  of  its  own  error,  omission,  negligence  or  default,  the  Contractor shall confirm in writing to the Subcontractor that the Period for Completion has been extended by the period of such delay and confirm the new Period for Completion. If the Contractor does not agree, it shall confirm in writing to the Subcontractor that the Period of Completion will not be extended with reasons for its decision.

children.name: text
children: Without  affecting  any  other  right  or  remedy  which  the  Contractor  may  possess,  if  the Subcontractor is, in the Contractor's opinion (such opinion to be final and conclusive) in breach of its obligations under Clause 4.1.2, then the Contractor may: (1) introduce additional labour onto the Subcontract Works (or any part of them) and any costs, expenses or losses which the Contractor incurs as a result may be deducted from any monies due or to become due to the Subcontractor or may be recoverable from the Subcontractor as a debt; and/or (2) omit any part of the Subcontract Works and may perform that work itself or by engaging others and the Subcontractor shall be liable for all additional costs incurred by the Contractor and shall have no claim for loss of profit, loss of contract or any loss arising from that omission.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall give the Contractor not less than 5 days' notice of the date when the Subcontractor considers the Subcontract Works will be practically complete. The Subcontractor may  enclose  with  this  notice  a  draft  snagging  list  to  be  agreed  with  the  Contractor  and remedied  by  the  Subcontractor  after  practical  completion  of  the  Subcontract  Works.  Upon receipt of the Subcontractor's notice the Contractor  will  attend  site  as  soon  as  reasonably practicable  to  inspect  the  Subcontract  Works. If  the  Contractor  does  not  consider  the Subcontract Works are practically complete then the process set out in this Clause 11.7 shall be  repeated  and  costs,  expenses  and  losses  (including  wasted  management  time)  which  the Contractor incurs in respect of all subsequent inspections of the Subcontract  Works shall be recoverable from the Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: The  Subcontract  Works  shall  not  be  considered  practically  complete  until  the  Subcontractor has provided: (1) all manufacturer guarantees and warranties required under the Subcontract; (2)  all  collateral  warranties  required  under  Clause  26;  (3)  all  operation  and  maintenance manuals required under the Subcontract; and (4) a written undertaking to the Contractor to complete all snagging items within a time period specified by the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Once  the  Subcontract  Works  are  practically  complete  in  accordance  with  Clause  11.8,  the Contractor  shall  sign  off  the  Subcontract  Works  by way  of  issuing  a  certificate  of  practical completion to the Subcontractor with attached snagging list.

children.name: text
children: {b:Site Conditions}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor is deemed to have inspected the Site and the physical conditions (including the sub-surface conditions and prior works) and other conditions of or affecting the Site and the  materials,  equipment,  and  facilities  required  to  carry  out  the  Subcontract  Works.  The Subcontractor is deemed to have fully acquainted itself with the same and to have obtained all  necessary  information  as  to  risks,  contingencies  and  all  other  circumstances  which  may influence or affect the execution of the Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: Before starting work on Site, the Subcontractor shall satisfy itself as to the suitability of all prior work to which the Subcontract Works are to be fixed or which may influence or affect the  carrying  out  of  or  the  quality  of  the  Subcontract  Works.  The  Subcontractor  shall immediately  notify  the  Contractor  of  any  prior  work  which  the  Subcontractor  considers  will affect the carrying out of or quality of the Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor is responsible for the accurate setting out of the Subcontract Works and is to  ensure  that  the  execution  of  the  Subcontract  Works  is  coordinated  with  the  work  of  the other subcontractors under the direction of the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Any information prepared  by or on behalf of the Contractor (including any survey, report or document)  relating  in  whole  or  in  part  to  the  physical  conditions  (including  the  sub-surface conditions  and  prior  works)  and  other  conditions  of  or  affecting  the  Site  is  provided  for information only. The Contractor makes no representation or warranty as to the accuracy or completeness  of  any  such  information  or  for  any  representation  or  statement  contained therein,  whether  made  negligently  or  otherwise  and  the  Subcontractor  shall  make  no  claim against  the  Contractor  for  misrepresentation  or  misstatement,  whether  made  negligently  or otherwise, in respect of such information.

children.name: text
children: No failure on the part of the Subcontractor to discover or foresee any physical conditions and/or other conditions affecting the site and/or any risks, prior work, contingencies or circumstances whatsoever  referred  to  in  this  Clause  12  (whether  the  same  ought  reasonably  to  have  been discovered or foreseen or not), shall entitle the Subcontractor to an adjustment of the Price or an extension of the Period for Completion.

children.name: text
children: {b:Method Statement}

children.name: text
children: Not less than 14 days before the Period for Completion is due to commence, the Subcontractor shall provide to the Contractor a Method Statement.

children.name: text
children: {b:Coordination}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall at all times collaboratively coordinate, consult with and co-operate with all other consultants and sub-contractors or suppliers engaged by the Contractor and/or the Employer in connection with the Project to the extent required in order to diligently carry out the Subcontract Works or as otherwise reasonably required by the Contractor from time to time.

children.name: text
children: {b:Defects}

children.name: text
children: During  the  Rectification  Period,  the  Subcontractor  shall  make  good  at  its  own  cost  and  in accordance with any instruction of the Contractor all defects, shrinkages and other faults in the Subcontract  Works  or  any  part  of  them due  to  materials,  goods  or  workmanship  not  in accordance  with  this  Subcontract  or  any  failure  of  the  Subcontractor  to  comply  with  its obligations in respect of the design of the Subcontract Works. Where the Contractor considers that such making good has been achieved, it shall notify the Subcontractor to that effect and the  date  of  that  notification  shall  be  no  later  than  the  issue  of  the  relevant  certificate  of making good under the Main Contract.

children.name: text
children: If  any  loss  or  damage  to  the  Project  (including  any  works  carried  out  by  specialist subcontractors) or completed Subcontract Works or any part thereof is caused by the existence of any defect or by the Subcontractor complying with any instruction issued under Clause 9.1 or Clause 15.1, the Contractor may issue instructions requiring such loss or damage to be made  good.  If  the  Contractor  shall  so  instruct,  the  Subcontractor  shall,  within  a  reasonable  time after receipt of the same, comply with such instruction at its own cost. The Subcontractor shall also  pay  the  cost  of  breaking  out  and  or  removal  and  reinstatement  or  replacement  by  the Contractor  (or  if  applicable  the  appropriate  specialist  subcontractor)  of  existing  works  as  a result of any such defect or as necessary in order to comply with an instruction under Clause 9.1 or Clause 15.1.

children.name: text
children: Failure by the Subcontractor to comply with the provisions of this Clause 15 shall entitle the Contractor  to  execute  those  outstanding  works  and  recover  all  associated  costs  from  the Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: {b:Payment}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall submit applications for payment on the dates set out in any schedule of  application  dates  quoting  the  Subcontract  Order  number  and  stating  the  sum  that  the Subcontractor considers to be due to the Subcontractor and the basis upon which that sum is calculated {b:("Subcontractor  Payment  Application")}. The due date shall be 7 days after the date that the Contractor receives the Subcontractor Payment Application {b:("Due Date")}. The final date for payment shall be {bred:42} days after the Due Date {b:("Final Date for Payment")}. Any Subcontractor Payment Application submitted other than at the dates or frequencies stated in any  schedule  of  application  dates  shall  be  considered  as  being  applicable  to  the  following month's application date.

children.name: text
children: The amount due to the Subcontractor shall be:

children.name: text
children: the total value of the work properly executed calculated in accordance with the rates and prices in the Subcontract; and

children.name: text
children: the amounts of any additions to the Price ascertained under the Subcontract;less

children.name: text
children: the amounts of any omissions to the Price ascertained under the Subcontract;

children.name: text
children: all amounts previously due;

children.name: text
children: (where applicable) retention under Clause 17;

children.name: text
children: any amounts due from the Subcontractor to the Contractor; and

children.name: text
children: any other amounts that the Contractor is entitled to withhold, deduct or set-off pursuant to the terms of the Subcontract or otherwise arising out of or in connection with the Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: Not later than 5 days after the Due Date the Contractor shall give a notice to the Subcontractor which will specify the sum that it considers to be or to have been due at the Due Date (even if that sum is zero or a negative amount) and the basis upon which that sum has been calculated {b:("Contractor  Payment  Notice")} and,  subject  to  Clause  16.5,  the  sum  to  be  paid  by  the Contractor shall be the sum specified in the Contractor Payment Notice.

children.name: text
children: If the Contractor fails to issue a Contractor's Payment Notice in accordance with Clause 16.3 the sum to be paid by the Contractor shall, subject to Clause 16.5, be the sum specified in the Subcontractor Payment Application.

children.name: text
children: If the Contractor intends to pay less than the sum specified in the Contractor Payment Notice or, if applicable, in the Subcontractor Payment Application, then it shall not later than one day before the Final Date for Payment give a notice to the Subcontractor specifying the sum that the Contractor considers to be due and the basis upon which that sum is calculated {b:("Pay Less Notice")}.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding  anything  to  the  contrary  in  the  Subcontract, the  Contractor  shall  not  be required to pay any sum due if the Subcontractor becomes Insolvent and has become Insolvent after the expiry of the one-day period for the service of a Pay Less Notice.

children.name: text
children: In the event that the Employer becomes Insolvent, the Contractor shall be obliged to pay to the Subcontractor any sums due pursuant to this Subcontract only if and when the Contractor receives such sums from the Employer.

children.name: text
children: {b:Retention}

children.name: text
children: Where the Subcontract Order states that retention applies, then retention may be deducted at the rate stated from all sums that become due prior to practical completion of the Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: Subject to receipt by the Contractor of a Subcontractor Payment Application in respect of the retention, one half of the retention shall become due to the Subcontractor six months after the later of practical completion of the Subcontract Works or (if applicable) the completion of any  snagging.  The  balance  of  the  retention  shall  fall  due  on  the  expiry  of  the  Rectification Period, provided always that the Subcontractor has made good all defects notified to it during the Rectification Period, otherwise it shall fall due once those outstanding defects have been rectified by the Subcontractor and signed off by the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: {b:Suspension}

children.name: text
children: Without affecting the Subcontractor's other rights and remedies, if the Contractor fails to pay the Subcontractor any sum payable by the Final Date for Payment and the failure continues for 7 days after the Subcontractor has given notice to the Contractor of its intention to suspend the performance of its obligations under the Subcontract and the ground or grounds on which it is intended to suspend performance, the Subcontractor may suspend performance of any or all of its obligations until payment is made in full.

children.name: text
children: Where  the  Subcontractor  exercises  its  right  of  suspension  under  this  Clause  18,  it  shall  be entitled to a reasonable amount in respect of costs and expenses properly incurred by it as a direct result of the suspension.

children.name: text
children: Any Subcontractor Payment Applications in respect of any such reasonable costs and expenses shall be made to the Contractor in accordance with Clause 16, attaching evidence of the same.

children.name: text
children: {b:Final Account}

children.name: text
children: No  later  than  14  days  after  the  date  of  practical  completion  of  the  Subcontract  Works,  the Subcontractor shall submit to the Contractor its final account.

children.name: text
children: The final account shall set out any claims for any extension of the Period for Completion and/or for any adjustments to the Price under this Subcontract or otherwise in connection with this Subcontract (together {b:"Claims"}) and the total of sums already paid by the Contractor to the Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: Notification of any Claims within the 14-day period stated in Clause 19.1 shall be a condition precedent to the Subcontractor's entitlement in respect of any Claim and the Contractor shall have no liability to the Subcontractor in respect of Claims notified after the expiry of that 14-day period.  The notification of any Claim by the Subcontractor within the 14-day period shall not be an acknowledgment of the Contractor's liability in respect of the notified Claim.

children.name: text
children: Except  as  disputed  and  amended  by  the  Contractor  prior  to  the  expiry  of  the  Rectification Period,  the  final  account  shall  be  conclusive  as  to  the  final  payment  to  be  made  by  the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The submission of the final account shall be treated as a Subcontractor's Payment Application for the purposes of this Clause 19, save that the due date for the final payment shall be 28 days after expiry of the Rectification Period.

children.name: text
children: {b:Set-Off}

children.name: text
children: Where  under  the  Subcontract  any  sum  of  money  is  recoverable  from  or  payable  by  the Subcontractor to the Contractor, such sum may be deducted from or reduced by the amount of any sum or sums then due or which at any time may become due to the Subcontractor under the Subcontract or any other contract with the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: {b:Title and Risk}

children.name: text
children: Title to the materials and goods tobe used in the Subcontract Works shall pass to the Contractor when  they  are  delivered  to  Site  or  when  they  are  paid  for  by  the  Contractor,  whichever  is earlier.

children.name: text
children: Where title to the materials and goods passes to the Contractor prior to delivery to Site, as a pre-condition to payment the Subcontractor is to set aside such materials in a separate place of storage clearly marked as the property of the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding that title to the materials, goods, or any part of them vests in the Contractor, they shall remain at the risk of the Subcontractor until incorporation into the Project.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall be responsible for the protection of the Subcontract Works against any damage  and  is  to  take  all  necessary  precautions  in  carrying  out  the  Subcontract  Works  to prevent damage to other existing works.

children.name: text
children: Risk in the plant, tools and equipment of the Subcontractor remains with the  Subcontractor and the Contractor shall have no liability for loss or damage to the same howsoever caused.

children.name: text
children: {b:Construction Industry Scheme ("CIS")}

children.name: text
children: This Clause 22 applies only if the CIS scheme is applicable to the Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor confirms it is and shall remain registered as a "subcontractor" under the CIS.  The  Subcontractor  shall  notify  the  Contractor  of  this  and  provide  any  necessary information and documentation to the Contractor before commencing any work on Site.

children.name: text
children: The  Subcontractor  is  not  entitled  to  payment  under  this  Subcontract  until  a  CIS  Card  or certificate is provided to the Contractor by the Subcontractor which the Contractor is satisfied is valid or the Subcontractor has produced satisfactory written evidence to the Contractor from the tax office of the Subcontractor to confirm that the CIS Card or certificate is valid.

children.name: text
children: If  the  Contractor  is  not  satisfied  with  the  validity  of  the  document  produced  by  the Subcontractor the Contractor will notify the Subcontractor in writing.

children.name: text
children: Without prejudice to any right of the Contractor to withhold payment, the Contractor at its sole discretion may make payment net of any statutory deduction in force at the time.

children.name: text
children: {b:Termination}

children.name: text
children: Without  affecting  any  other  rights  which  the  Contractor  may  have,  the  Contractor  shall  be entitled by written notice to the Subcontractor to terminate the Subcontractor's employment under the Subcontract forthwith if the Subcontractor:

children.name: text
children: s in breach of any obligation under the Subcontract which it fails to remedy within 5 days of a written notice from the Contractor specifying the breach and requiring that it be remedied within that period; or

children.name: text
children: is Insolvent; or

children.name: text
children: is unable to pay its debts or has taken any steps towards a formal insolvency process; or

children.name: text
children: notifies the Contractor that the Subcontractor has ceased trading.

children.name: text
children: Upon termination of its employment, the Subcontractor shall:

children.name: text
children: take immediate steps to bring the Subcontract Works to a halt in a safe and orderly manner but with all reasonable speed and economy (including advising and assisting the Contractor in relation the protection and preservation of the Project);

children.name: text
children: remove its plant, equipment, vehicles, and property from Site;

children.name: text
children: allow the Contractor free use of its plant, materials, and property on Site and any materials or fabricated work lying at the Subcontractor's workshops for the purposes of the Subcontract Works;

children.name: text
children: hand over all Documents to the Contractor; and

children.name: text
children: comply with any other reasonable instruction from the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Upon  termination,  the  Contractor  shall  not  be  bound  to  make  any  further  payment  to  the Subcontractor  until  the  full  and  final  cost  of  completion  of  the  Subcontract  Works  and  the making good of any  defects, whether by the Contractor or  by others, has  been ascertained. Upon such costs being ascertained, the Contractor shall calculate the amount of any damage, loss and/or expense suffered or incurred by the Contractor. If the amount of any such damage, loss and/or expense incurred when added to the monies paid to the Subcontractor prior to the termination exceeds in total a fair and reasonable proportion of the Price commensurate with the proportion of the Subcontract Works properly carried out by the Subcontractor prior to the date of such termination, the difference shall be a debt recoverable by the Contractor from the Subcontractor, but otherwise shall be payable by the Contractor to the Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: If  the  Contractor's employment under the Main Contract is terminated for any reason, the employment  of  the  Subcontractor  shall  terminate  automatically  on  the  same  date  without notice  to  the  Subcontractor,  and  the  Subcontractor  shall  comply  with  Clause  23.2. The Contractor's sole liability to the Subcontractor shall be in respect of the Subcontract Works executed up to the date of termination. The Subcontractor shall within 14 days of termination of the Contractor's employment under the Main Contract submit a Subcontractor  Payment Application for Subcontract Works properly executed by it up to the date of termination. Such Subcontractor  Payment  Application  shall  be  treated  in  all  respects  as  if  it  were  the Subcontractor's final account submitted pursuant to Clause 19.

children.name: text
children: {b:Indemnity}

children.name: text
children: The  Subcontractor  shall  indemnify  and  hold  harmless  the  Contractor  against  all  claims, demands,  losses,  costs,  and  expenses  (including  legal  expenses  and  other  professional  fees) arising out of or in connection with:

children.name: text
children: any breach by the Subcontractor of this Subcontract;

children.name: text
children: any  personal  injury  or  death  of  any  person  or  damage  to  property  caused  by  the carrying  out  of  the  Subcontract  Works,  except  if  and  to  the  extent  caused  by negligence of the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: {b:Insurances}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall maintain the following insurances at all times during the Project:

children.name: text
children: public liability insurance of at least the amount stated in the Subcontract Order for each and every claim;

children.name: text
children: employer's liability insurance of at least the amount stated in the Subcontract Order for each and every claim;

children.name: text
children: where  the  Subcontractor  is  responsible  for  carrying  out  design,  professional indemnity insurance of at least the amount stated in the Subcontract Order for each and every claim.

children.name: text
children: Insurance  policies  pursuant to  Clauses  25.1.1  and  25.1.2  shall  be  maintained  by  the Subcontractor until the expiry of the Rectification Period.

children.name: text
children: Professional  indemnity  insurance  pursuant  to  Clause  25.1.3  shall  be  maintained  by  the Subcontractor provided always that such insurance continues to be available on commercially reasonable rates and terms, having regard (inter alia) to the premiums required by insurers and the policy terms obtainable by the Subcontractor, until 12 years after practical completion of the Subcontract Works. Any increased or additional premiums required by insurers because of the Subcontractor's own claims record or other acts, omissions, matters or things peculiar to the Subcontractor shall be deemed to be within commercially reasonable rates and terms for the purposes of this Clause 25.3.

children.name: text
children: All  insurance  is  to  be  with  an  insurer  acceptable  to  the  Contractor  and  not  subject  to  any material excess or unusual exclusions.

children.name: text
children: As and when reasonably required so to do, the Subcontractor shall provide the Contractor with documentary  evidence  that  the  insurances  required  hereunder  are  in  force  and  are  being maintained.

children.name: text
children: If  the  Subcontractor  fails  to  effect  or  maintain  any  required  insurance  the  Contractor  may insure  on  behalf  of  the  Subcontractor  and  set-off the  cost  against  any  monies  due  to  the Subcontractor or recover the cost as a debt.

children.name: text
children: {b:Collateral Warranties}

children.name: text
children: Within 7 days' notice from the Contractor and as a precondition to payment, the Subcontractor shall enter into and deliver to the Contractor a deed or deeds of collateral warranty with the Employer  and/or  any  funder,  lessee  or  purchaser  in  the  form  or  forms  annexed  to  the Subcontract  or  in  such  other  substantially  similar  form  or  forms  as  the  Contractor  may reasonably require.

children.name: text
children: Within 7 days' notice from the Contractor and as a precondition to payment, the Subcontractor shall  enter  into  and  deliver  to  the  Contractor  a  deed  or  deeds  of  sub-collateral  warranty  in favour  of  the  Contractor  and  the  Employer  from  any  consultant  and/or  sub-sub-contractor employed by the Sub-Contractor to carry out any design and/or construction of the Subcontract Works in the form or forms annexed to the Subcontract or in such other substantially similar form or forms as the Contractor may reasonably require.  Each sub-collateral warranty shall have attached a copy of relevant underlying sub-agreement (with any commercially sensitive information redacted if necessary).

children.name: text
children: {b:Assignment}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor may not assign, sub-contract or otherwise transfer the whole or any part of the benefit of, or any of the Subcontractor's rights or obligations under, this Subcontract without the Contractor's prior written consent, which the Contractor may give or withhold in the Contractor's absolute discretion.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may freely assign or charge the benefit of this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: {b:Third Party Rights}

children.name: text
children: Any person who is not a party to this Subcontract has no right under the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999 to enforce any term or condition of this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: {b:Confidentiality}

children.name: text
children: Save  as  required  by  law,  the  Subcontractor  shall  not  and  shall  procure  that  its  employees, agents  and  representatives  shall  not  without  the  prior  written  approval  of  the  Contractor publish  or  disclose  to  any  person  (other  than legal  advisers)  any  of  the  Documents  or  other information relating to the Project and/or this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall not without the prior written approval of the Contractor take or permit to be taken any photographs or video or other written or graphic media of the Project for use in any publicity or advertising.

children.name: text
children: {b:Data Protection}

children.name: text
children: The  Subcontractor  shall,  at  its  own  expense,  ensure  that  it  complies  with  and  assists  the Contractor to comply with the requirements of the Data Protection Laws in all respects relevant and  applicable  to  the  Project,  the  Subcontract  Works  and  the  performance  of  both  parties' obligations under this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: Any  breach  of  this  Clause  30  by  the  Subcontractor  shall  entitle  the  Contractor  to  recover damages for any cost, expense, loss, or fine incurred by the Contractor which is attributable to the failure of the Subcontractor to meet its obligations under this Clause 30 on an indemnity basis.

children.name: text
children: {b:Anti-Bribery and Modern Slavery}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor hereby warrants, represents and undertakes to the Contractor that it shall:

children.name: text
children: comply with all applicable laws, statutes, regulations, and codes relating to anti-bribery and anti-corruption {b:("Relevant Requirements")}, including, but not limited to, the UK Bribery Act 2010 {b:("Bribery Act")};

children.name: text
children: not engage in any activity, practice or conduct which would constitute an offence under the Bribery Act;

children.name: text
children: not do, or omit to do, any act that will cause or lead the Contractor to be in breach of any of the Relevant Requirements;

children.name: text
children: ensure that any person associated with it who is performing design and/or works in connection with this Subcontract (including any sub-sub-contractor or consultant) does so only on the basis of a written contract which imposes on and secures from such person terms equivalent to those imposed  on  the  Subcontractor  in  this  Clause  31  {b:("Relevant  Terms")}  and  that  it  shall  be responsible for the observance and performance by  such person of the  Relevant Terms, and shall be directly liable to the Contractor for any breach by such person of any of the Relevant Terms;

children.name: text
children: comply and procure that  persons associated with it and other persons who are  performing design and/or works in connection with this Subcontract shall comply with applicable laws and  regulations  (as  amended  from  time  to  time)  related  to  trade  secrets  or  unfair competition, tax evasion, employment of child labour and modern slavery including, without limitation, the UK Modern Slavery Act 2015 and UK Criminal Finances Act 2017;

children.name: text
children: keep  detailed,  accurate  and  up-to-date  records  showing  all  payments  made  by  it  in connection with performance of its obligations under this Subcontract and, upon reasonable notice, allow the Contractor and its representatives to inspect these records and take copies of them;

children.name: text
children: maintain appropriate anti-bribery, anti-corruption and anti-fraud policies and abide by the provisions of those policies and procure that its employees, and any persons associated with it, abide by those policies;

children.name: text
children: implement appropriate due diligence procedures for its sub-sub-contractors/ consultants and suppliers to ensure compliance under this Clause 31;

children.name: text
children: Any breach of any of the representations and warranties under this Clause 31, or any breach by  any  sub-sub-contractor/  consultant  of  the  Relevant  Terms,  shall  represent  a  material breach of this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may, by written notice issued to the Subcontractor, require the Subcontractor immediately to suspend or determine the employment of any sub-sub-contractor/ consultant engaged by the Subcontractor in connection with the Project, and shall not be required to give reasons for the same.

children.name: text
children: The  Subcontractor  shall  indemnify  and  hold  harmless  the  Contractor  against  and  from  any claim, damage, loss or expense due to or resulting from:

children.name: text
children: any breach of the UK Modern Slavery Act 2015 by the Subcontractor including all parties involved in the delivery of the Subcontract Works for or on behalf of the Subcontractor  including  (without  limitation)  any  of  its  employees,  sub-sub-contractors and consultants; and

children.name: text
children: any   of   its   employees,   sub-sub-contractors,   any   labour   provided   to   the Subcontractor by third party labour agencies and consultants not having the right to work in the United Kingdom.

children.name: text
children: {b:Adjudication}

children.name: text
children: The Contractor or the Subcontractor at any time may notify the other of its intention to  a dispute or difference arising under the Subcontract for adjudication in accordance with the adjudication  rules  Version  2.0  published  by  the  Technology  and  Construction  Solicitors Association {b:("TeCSA")}.

children.name: text
children: The  adjudicator  to  whom  the  dispute  is  referred  is  such  person  as  the  Contractor  and  the Subcontractor choose by mutual agreement or such other person appointed as the adjudicator on the request of either of the Contractor or the Subcontractor by the Chairman of TeCSA.
